name: Agatsuma Zenitsu

ruler.note: Same physical ruler as Tanjiro (both about 165 cm): every production sheet draws the upright figure at one size, so every clip shares one resample factor.
ruler.scale_note: Recalibrated 2026-10-15 on the production drawings. The approved key (543x605, iai stance) measures hair top to chin 150 and a head ruler of 120.6. The v3 model sheet is 6.5 heads (hair top to chin 139 of 901), but the generated sheets draw him standing at about 6 heads: standing drawings (victory) are 6.9-7.2 head rulers tall, so at the key's head size he would stand about 850 key px. model_head_px / model_height_px are therefore the key's 150 over that 850, which makes him 340 px standing like Tanjiro (runtime hair top to chin about 60 px, Tanjiro 61; key scale 0.40, idle about 242 px = 71% of standing). Scaling by the model sheet instead (139/901) left standing drawings at 297 px.

palette.note: Material targets are measured from the approved v3 idle key at run time (process.canonical); the colour classes are "anatomy" and "materials" below.

identity: Agatsuma Zenitsu: slim teenage swordsman, 6.5 heads tall (as the model sheet); short spiky blond hair that turns orange toward the tips; amber-brown eyes, thin eyebrows; he fights ASLEEP, so his eyes stay CLOSED in every drawing unless a frame says they open; open haori with a vertical yellow-to-orange gradient (bright yellow at the shoulders, orange at the hem) covered with small white triangles of equal size everywhere, cream lining; black Demon Slayer Corps jacket with white collar trim and silver buttons; white belt with a square buckle; wide black trousers gathered below the knee; yellow-to-orange leg wraps with white triangles tied with white bows; dark sandals; katana with a pale steel blade, white hilt wrap with gold diamonds, round gold tsuba, white scabbard with a gold tip on the left hip.
style: Crisp premium anime ink outlines with consistent line weight, flat cel shading with one shadow tone, modern 2D fighting-game sprite finish.

canon.colours: haori bright yellow #f2c447 at the shoulders blending to orange #f08a2c at the hem, white #f6f4ee triangles about 40 px wide, the same size on every view; jacket and trousers black #26201f; leg wraps yellow to orange with white triangles; skin #f7d2b0; hair blond #f4d35e turning orange #f09a3a at the tips.
canon.model_pose: relaxed neutral standing, arms slightly away from the body, nervous but calm face, katana sheathed on the left hip.
candidates: Column 1, Thunder Breathing iai stance (asleep): the First Form ready pose. Low wide stance, front knee deeply bent, rear leg stretched back, torso leaning far forward over the front knee; the katana SHEATHED on the left hip, his left hand gripping the scabbard just below the guard, his right hand on the hilt ready to draw; eyes CLOSED, face calm and serious (he fights asleep).

Column 2, half-body iai (awake): a medium crouch, torso more upright and turned side-on toward the opponent; the katana SHEATHED, left thumb pressing the guard, right hand resting lightly on the hilt; eyes OPEN, sharp and focused, mouth closed.

Column 3, after the flash: knees bent, weight forward; the katana DRAWN and held low in his right hand, the blade trailing BACKWARD behind him, its tip down near the floor to the LEFT of his rear foot; the empty scabbard in his left hand at the hip; eyes CLOSED, calm.

Sword orientation (critical, every figure faces RIGHT): the scabbard hangs on his LEFT hip with the HILT pointing FORWARD toward the opponent (to the RIGHT, in front of his belly) and the scabbard TIP pointing BACKWARD (to the LEFT, behind his hip). Never draw the hilt behind him.

All three: the whole katana clearly visible (pale steel blade when drawn, white hilt wrap with gold diamonds, round gold tsuba, white scabbard with a gold tip), haori open and hanging naturally with a slight flare at the hem, triangles the same size as the model sheet.

prompt.note: Rulers measured on the approved key: iai stance 605 px, upright about 970 px (model sheet ratio), hair top to chin 150 px, scabbard about 375 px so the blade is about 365 px.
prompt.katana: there is only ONE katana. Unless a frame says the sword is drawn, it stays SHEATHED on his left hip: the white scabbard with its gold tip points BACKWARD (to the LEFT, behind his hip) and the hilt points FORWARD toward the opponent (to the RIGHT, in front of his belly), never backward. Once it is drawn the scabbard is EMPTY: no hilt and no guard at its mouth, only the white scabbard in his left hand or at his hip, its gold tip ALWAYS pointing BACKWARD (to the LEFT), never forward. Drawn, the pale steel blade from the round gold guard to the tip is about 365 px, as long as the scabbard in input image 1. Never shorten it; when it points straight forward or across the body, show its full length.
prompt.katana_edit: the drawn pale steel blade from the guard to the tip is about 365 px, as long as the scabbard in input image 1. Never shorten it; a sheathed katana keeps its hilt pointing FORWARD.
prompt.effects: lightning, sparks, glow, trails or speed lines

anatomy.note: Inclusive OpenCV HSV boxes (h 0-179, wraps when low > high; s and v 0-255). Hair, haori and leg wraps share one yellow-to-orange range (gold), so hair_cut keeps only gold on the far side of the chin (seen from the body centre) within radius face sizes of the face. Skin excludes the cream haori lining and the leg bandages (lower saturation or darker).

materials.note: The haori (and the leg wraps) is a vertical yellow-to-orange gradient: locked as two hue bands so a pose showing more hem does not pull the yellow toward orange. Hair is QA only.

awakening.note: Thunder Breathing, Godspeed: the gold materials (haori, leg wraps, hair) brighter and more saturated; alpha untouched (awaken.py). A 2 px gold rim was tried at checkpoint 2 and dropped: on the dark trousers it reads as a muddy outline, and the in-game awakening aura already gives the glow (rim_px 0).

qa.note: The idle is the low iai stance (71% of standing). upright: standing frames vs the idle (1.41 x 0.93-1.07; a pose's "upright_frames" limits the check to those frames). stance: low-stance clips such as the walk, a little taller than the idle. length_px: an upright body in key pixels, the longest a stretched-out drawing may be (the wide key's main axis is shorter than his body). idle_vs_upright: the idle height as a share of standing (tests compare low poses with standing). overlap_head_limit: an overlap frame calibrates its sheet by height only while that agrees with the sheet's head ruler within this share (a redrawn overlap in another pose shrank the thunder recovery to 87%). head_outlier_limit: an upright sheet whose head scale is this far off the clip median takes the median (a bowed, shaded face measured only the bangs and asked for 1.6x in iai_return).
